# lingmatch

An all-in-one R package for the assessment of linguistic matching and/or
accommodation.

## features

- Input raw text, a document-term matrix (DTM), or LIWC output.
- Apply various weighting functions to a DTM.
- Measure similarity and/or accommodation with various metrics.
- Calculate standard forms of Language Style Matching (LSM) and Latent
  Semantic Similarity (LSS).

## installation

Download R from [r-project.org](https://www.r-project.org/), then
install the package from an R console:

Release ([version 1.0.7](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=lingmatch))

``` r

install.packages("lingmatch")
```

Development (version 1.0.8)

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("miserman/lingmatch")
```

And load the package:

``` r

library(lingmatch)
```

## examples

Can make a quick comparison between two bits of text; by default this
will give the cosine similarity between raw word-count vectors:

``` r

lingmatch("First text to look at.", "Text to compare that text with.")
```

Or, given a vector of texts:

``` r

text = c(
  "Why, hello there! How are you this evening?",
  "I am well, thank you for your inquiry!",
  "You are a most good at social interactions person!",
  "Why, thank you! You're not all bad yourself!"
)
```

Process the texts in one step:

``` r

# with a dictionary
inquirer_cats = lma_process(text, dict = "inquirer", dir = "~/Dictionaries")

# with a latent semantic space
glove_vectors = lma_process(text, space = "glove", dir = "~/Latent Semantic Spaces")
```

Or process the texts step by step, then measure similarity between each:

``` r

dtm = lma_dtm(text)
dtm_weighted = lma_weight(dtm)
dtm_categorized = lma_termcat(dtm_weighted, lma_dict(1:9))
similarity = lma_simets(dtm_categorized, metric = "canberra")
```

Or do that within a single function call:

``` r

similarity = lingmatch(
  text, weight = "frequency", dict = lma_dict(1:9), metric = "canberra"
)$sim
```

Or, if you want a standard form (as in this example), specify a default:

``` r

similarity = lingmatch(text, type = "lsm")$sim
```

# Package index

## Top-Level Functions

These are entry-level functions that try to be easy to use by automating
things.

- [`lingmatch()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lingmatch.md)
  : Linguistic Matching and Accommodation
- [`lma_process()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_process.md)
  : Process Text
- [`lma_meta()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_meta.md)
  : Calculate Text-Based Metastatistics

## Component Functions

These are the build blocks of the top-level functions.

- [`lma_dtm()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_dtm.md)
  : Document-Term Matrix Creation
- [`lma_weight()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_weight.md)
  : Document-Term Matrix Weighting
- [`lma_lspace()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_lspace.md)
  : Latent Semantic Space (Embeddings) Operations
- [`lma_termcat()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_termcat.md)
  : Document-Term Matrix Categorization
- [`lma_patcat()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_patcat.md)
  : Categorize Texts
- [`lma_simets()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_simets.md)
  : Similarity Calculations

## Utilities

These help prepare your environment or data if needed, or do additional
analysis.

- [`read.dic()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/read.dic.md)
  [`write.dic()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/read.dic.md)
  : Read/Write Dictionary Files
- [`read.segments()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/read.segments.md)
  : Read and Segment Multiple Texts
- [`lma_initdirs()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_initdirs.md)
  : Initialize Directories for Dictionaries and Latent Semantic Spaces
- [`lma_dict()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/lma_dict.md)
  : English Function Word Category and Special Character Lists
- [`select.dict()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/select.dict.md)
  : Select Dictionaries
- [`download.dict()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/download.dict.md)
  : Download Dictionaries
- [`select.lspace()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/select.lspace.md)
  : Select Latent Semantic Spaces
- [`download.lspace()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/download.lspace.md)
  : Download Latent Semantic Spaces
- [`standardize.lspace()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/standardize.lspace.md)
  : Standardize a Latent Semantic Space
- [`report_term_matches()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/report_term_matches.md)
  : Generate a Report of Term Matches
- [`dictionary_meta()`](https://miserman.github.io/lingmatch/reference/dictionary_meta.md)
  : Assess Dictionary Categories Within a Latent Semantic Space
